method: belief -> rival -> probe -> observation -> update -> verifier

traces.belief: Habitat can separate source/execution backend without changing cognition semantics.
traces.rival: Backend separation will change semantic IDs, graph answers, task context or mutations.
traces.probe: Run identical fixture under local and directory-mirror backends and compare before/after semantic signatures, context and canonical mutation.
traces.observation: Fresh equivalence report shows semantic/context/canonical equivalence; execution provenance differs as expected.

traces.belief: A mirror compiler view may be used for compilation while exact source remains backend-authoritative.
traces.rival: Some code paths will still read mirror bytes as exact evidence.
traces.probe: Audit direct source reads and external-authority drift during context page fault.
traces.observation: Residency contained a direct mirror read and was corrected; drift invalidates context before source fault.

traces.belief: Known changed paths can avoid an O(project) remote listing tax.
traces.rival: Targeted backend hydration still enumerates the backend or materialized workspace.
traces.probe: Edit one authority file and call refresh_paths(['auth.py']).
traces.observation: First backend patch still left workspace enumeration; corrected. Final receipt reports targeted-no-enumeration, one path considered, one hash.

traces.belief: Prior context use can improve future attention without becoming truth.
traces.rival: Feedback becomes self-fulfilling and invents relevance.
traces.probe: Record used/unhelpful only for ranked candidates; try unknown candidate; inspect bounded score lane.
traces.observation: Unknown candidate is rejected; utility only adjusts existing candidate with bounded score and separate lane.

traces.belief: A page planner should be able to refuse source acquisition on no-gold tasks.
traces.observation: Planner returns abstain-or-broaden-query and reads zero source bytes on fixtures and supplied AGI corpus.

traces.belief: Long-horizon continuity needs executable workflow provenance beyond narrative checkpoints.
traces.probe: Link context, transaction, commit revision, verification, checkpoint and episode outcome.
traces.observation: Episode ledger retains links and causality.explain returns the owning workflow; checkpoint may bind active episode and backend identity.

claim_boundary: The trace records engineering hypothesis tests. It is not evidence that the software or assistant is AGI.
